import numpy as np, math

cx,cy,h=1.674,0.779,30.0

    if len(c): print('u',u,'top',c.min(),'bot',c.max())
print('--- leg per col')
for u in range(215,300,5):
    c=np.nonzero(leg[:,u])[0]

print('--- wall base resection (white north wall)')
w=(R>240)&(G>238)&(B>232)

    if len(c): print('u',u,'bot',c.max())
